title: requeued
description: The issue's claim was given back and the issue is in the queue again (ready label on), for any device to take. Written by callum-flow-sweep when a lease ran out, and by the loop's reconcile or factory-reconcile when it released a claim with no live work behind it and put the issue back in the queue. Ends the claim. A reconcile release that takes the issue out of the factory is abandoned instead.

reason.description: Why: lease-expired (no renewal in time) or reconcile (reconcile found no live work behind the claim and requeued it).

stage.description: reconcile: the stage callum-flow-factory-state showed the issue in, in its words (queued, designing, implementing, in pipeline, parked), not a transition state; null otherwise.

lives.description: reconcile: the released life's number among the issue's lives, when known; null otherwise.

branch.description: The released work's branch, when known.

pr.description: The released work's open pull request, when there is one.

detail.description: reconcile: what was checked, one line for people; never parse it. null otherwise.

examples.detail: this device's live claim has no record and no claim in flight
